CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation linked to content organization in the text.

COD.rationale: Content (red positions), organization/presentation (conditional/native record origin) and status (executed_branch_claim=false) are explicitly bound for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition linked to the same content's presentation/access.

C.rationale: Multiple record lines explicitly identify contents (red/blue) with positional attributes.

D.rationale: Origins and flags (e.g. executed_branch_claim=false, copied_prior_record) separately mark content status/organization apart from content identity.

O.rationale: Text states presentation/organization (grid orientation) and records conditional/current presentation via origin metadata.
